categories_thin: Hardware / general home-center retail: no conventional independent hardware store exists inside the township; the nearest independents are in Jamesburg borough and the rest are chains. Burroughs Hardwoods (specialty lumber/flooring) is the only independent building-materials retailer found.

Music store / bookstore: only national chains (Guitar Center, Music & Arts, Barnes & Noble) appear for Monroe; music tuition exists (Island Music Studios, private instructors) but no independent instrument or book shop.
Hotels: only chain properties (DoubleTree, Hyatt House, Travelers Inn in Dayton) were returned; no independent hotel or inn found in the township.
Event venues: thin - Forsgate Country Club is the main private venue; other banquet space in the township is HOA/municipal or attached to restaurants, which are out of scope.
Toy, hobby and general gift retail: very thin; gift-type retail is mostly florists and garden-center gift shops.
Veterinary, medical, dental, legal, accounting, insurance, real estate and the rest of groups A and B were outside this brief (group D only).
caveats: Municipality rule applied strictly: Jamesburg borough shares ZIP 08831 and sits inside the 10-mile radius but is a separate municipality, so Jamesburg/Dayton/Cranbury-address businesses were excluded. Removed from the earlier draft for this reason: Katie's Pet Depot (416 Renaissance Blvd, North Brunswick), All Brunswick Moving & Storage (182 J Ridge Rd, Dayton), RKS Plastics (1075 Cranbury South River Rd, Unit 5, Jamesburg), Iron Cycles Inc (225 Forsgate Dr, Jamesburg), System Freight (7 Centre Dr, Jamesburg), Victory Worldwide Transportation (1045 Cranbury South River Rd, Jamesburg per its own site), Ankur International (1206 Cranbury South River Rd, Cranbury per its own site).

Removed for being non-operating or a franchise: Shima Seiki USA (NJ office closed and the Abeel Rd building sold, per the verifier's trade-press finding) and PALS Learning Center (palslc.com is a franchise system, and franchises are an excluded type).

Entries that rested only on the scraped us-business.info aggregator were re-tested and dropped unless a second, independent source confirmed them: Bryant Nursery, Tom Iadevaia & Son Nursery, Raritan Valley Nursery, Trocobel USA, The Pet Au Pairs, Sunset Enterprises Television Repair, Best Wireless, All About Appliances, Apple Dry Cleaners, Sun Ray Cleaner, Rishi Thukral Photography, Realist Video Productions, Superior Tractor Trailer Training, Top Notch Events, Top Quality Chair Covers, Ultravision, Tyler Distribution, Sweeney Seed Co, Revere Smelting & Refining, PSS, Phytomedics, Brunswick Office Supply & Service, United Driving School (Brier Hill Ct is in East Brunswick).

Private preschools and child-care centres (Ellie's Academy, Hop to It, MAARS Academy) were kept: the brief's group D explicitly includes 'childcare and preschools', and the exclusion list names public schools and universities rather than private early-years providers. If the client meant to exclude all schools, these three should be removed.

National/regional chains and franchises were excluded: Childtime, Kiddie Academy, The Goddard School, Kumon, Mathnasium, Best Brains, JEI, School of Rock, Crown Trophy, FASTSIGNS, Mr. Appliance, Club Z!, U-Haul, Costco/Wakefern/Barnes & Noble distribution centres, Canon, Berry Global, Cargotec, Mitsubishi Electric, DMG Mori, Bracco, Invacare, TW Metals, Tricorbraun.

The Jersey Grown garden-center directory is a state agriculture listing and undated, so several nursery rows (Arbe, Baker's, A.N.T., Belotti, Farmer Al's, Tidbury Creek, Twin Sweet, Brunswick Tree Farm) are directory evidence only and need a live check before outreach.
Several addresses sit on municipal lines (Public Rd, Mounts Mills Rd, Cranbury South River Rd, Forsgate Dr) - municipality should be confirmed from the tax record during triage.
Map-derived rows carry the map listing as their only evidence; the visitor-view map search shows a limited result set, so very small or unclaimed businesses may still be missing.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable, so OSM data was not used.
Yellowpages.com, Cylex, Opendi, ChamberofCommerce.com, WhereOrg and localitybiz returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; for those only search-result content was usable.
Monroe Township's own website has no current searchable business directory; the indexed business lists are from 2011 and 2016 and were not treated as active evidence.
Phone numbers for several small/home-based businesses were not published and are marked Unknown.
Monroe Jewelers' street address is supported by the Concordia tenant roster; its own site does not print the street address.
Championship Awards Group publishes phone numbers but no street address; the address shown is the one most directories list and conflicts with an older listing.
Pawsitive Reflections' booking page is JavaScript-only, so only its address and phone from directory listings could be read.
Southern Monroe Township below roughly latitude 40.305 (far Federal Rd / Englishtown Rd) falls outside the 10-mile radius and was only partially checked.
